action: Acquire publication lease through heredoc script and read /dev/tty
error: OSError [Errno 6] No such device or address /dev/tty
effect: The descriptor closed when the process exited; no publication action occurred. The subsequent functions store of absent session_id also failed, so no clone was started in that invocation.
resolution: A direct python -c process reads its provided stdin; exclusive publication lease retained in a live tool session.
